# Contributing to Nativefier

## Issues

Open an issue with one of the
[issue forms](https://github.com/ABuljko/nativefier/issues/new/choose); they ask
for everything needed to reproduce your problem.

## Pull Requests

See [HACKING.md](https://github.com/ABuljko/nativefier/blob/main/HACKING.md) to
set up a development environment, and for the guidelines we ask contributions to
follow.

CI runs lint and tests on every pull request, so running them locally is
optional, but these commands might be helpful:

```bash
npm run lint
npm test

# Auto-fix lint errors and reformat
npm run lint:fix && npm run lint:format
```

Thank you so much for your contribution!
